TaskTeam gained one optional field beyond the brief's shape, planTurn: the task turn in which the big plan was sent back to be shown. Only a reply in a later turn can approve the plan, which is what stops a yes from the original request (or a second hire_members call in the same turn) from approving it.

The big-plan gate is decided by the host, not only by the model's big flag: a coding job (word match on the goal, roles and briefs), more than three members in one call, or big:true. A long non-coding job with one to three members is gated only if the lead passes big:true. Members hiring helpers are not gated.

A member that reports while a helper it hired is unreviewed gets one reminder turn; if it still has not reviewed, it is marked failed and the helper is released without a review. A member that asks the person a question or hits the token budget with unreviewed helpers has them released without a review as well.

A team task is done only when a result check passed and every member is released; an unreviewed member turns an accepted check into one retry and then waiting. This also holds on the offered-alternative path.
A member's question reaches the person through the lead calling ask_person with the returned line; the host does not force that call.
The lead's own turn budget is fixed at turn start, so members can take the task past TASK_TOKEN_BUDGET by what the lead still spends in that turn.
